description: TY2026 single expat: 150,000 foreign wages, exclusion capped at $132,900 (Rev. Proc. 2025-32 SS 4.39). AGI 17,100, TI 1,000. SS 911(f) STACKING: tax = tax(1,000 + 132,900) - tax(132,900) = 24,734 - 24,494 = $240.00 — the remaining $1,000 is taxed at 24%, not 10%. (Naive brackets on 1,000 would give $100 — the stacking rule doubles it and change.)
